verdict.rationale: Requesty documents an MCP Gateway where users register MCP servers, explore their tools, and configure authentication, including per-user keys on Enterprise. Coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor and Roo Code then reach those servers' tools through Requesty, with usage analytics on top. Missing for 10: any evidence that MCP tools can be invoked server-side within router chat-completion requests (rather than only proxied to client agents), step-by-step setup detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
